text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I finished a bit of overtime and was about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Buonasera, Trainer.
The moon is quite beautiful tonight.
choice_data_list: What are you doing at this hour?
What are you doing at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Visitors"...
Neo Universe and the others came to "observe."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it that it appears in the sky above the academy.
A mysterious light that plays music every night...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oho, molto interessante!
As a musician, I would love nothing more than to face you.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Last time was a 'Close Encounter of the Second Kind'... but the 'transmission' from 'our side'... resulted in an 'error', didn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You never know, Astronauta.
For music is a universal language!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering if a mysterious light would really appear...
I decided to accompany her since I was worried.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I gazed at the night sky for a while...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Shall I play a tune then?
A serenade, perhaps, while we wait for her entrance...
(Vroom, vroom, vroom...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, I saw a mysterious light
hovering with a low humming noise!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
See, told you... "Music"...
"Vroom vroom"...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No, this sound that the light makes resound...!
It's truly a magnificent symphony...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
What a bellissima melodia...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us play!
Wherever musicians gather, it becomes a concert!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Here, please accept this!
It is a love song from me to you!
(Vroom... ROOOAR, ROOOOAR!)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Big Bang"...!
The "Visitor" is "reacting"...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"More! Tell me more!
Express yourself through music!"
(*BOOOOOM, BAAAAM!*)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...'Jupiter'... Voyager...
So this is the 'Visitor's'..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The sound emitted by the light still doesn't sound like music to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, playing along to Sounds of Earth,
it sounded just like an ensemble—
choice_data_list: No, it's a conversation through sound...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final measure!!
Match your breathing—!!

text_block_list.name: Earth and Friends
text_block_list.text:
Dan! Da, RUUUUUN!!
(Vroom, VROOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the performance ended, the night's silence enveloped the surroundings.
The light gradually faded away...
(*whistle*......)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Arrivederci.
To the musician far, far away."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth... closed the "distance."
Your "music" is "interactive."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That's super... "quasar"!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! *Grazie mille*...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I am honored by your praise, Astronauta!
Those words are a first-magnitude star that makes me shine!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……is "Doppler."
I "seek"……a "reenactment" with the "Visitor."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you try playing too when the time comes?
A conversation across the stars
will make your heart soar even higher."
choice_data_list: I want to join too, to knock some sense into my suspicious mind.
I want to join too, to knock some sense into my suspicious mind.
Th-This conversation is on such a high plane, I can barely follow...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Why don't you try playing too when the time comes?
A conversation across the stars
will make your heart soar even higher."
choice_data_list: I want to join too, to knock some sense into my suspicious mind.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with doubt, amico.
What matters is the music you play, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing wrong with doubt, amica.
What matters is the music you play, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's a great melodía,
Universe-san! Keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Preparing to make contact with the mysterious light,
we practiced playing our instruments together with Sounds of Earth and the others.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's not complicated, amico.
I just want to play music again with those travelers of the cosmos—
that's all there is to it.
choice_data_list: I wonder when "they" will come next?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It's not complicated, amica.
I just want to play music again with those travelers of the cosmos—
that's all there is to it.
choice_data_list: I wonder when "they" will come next?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The possibilities are "unknown"...
What Neo Universe and the others touched
was a fragment of the "Monolith"...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: “Indeed. If we desire an encore, we must begin by understanding it.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I investigated the mysterious light
together with Sounds of Earth and the others.
